Global assumptions

Edit any value — every tab recalculates instantly. Values are remembered in this browser.
Currency conversion
Base currency is AED. Rates convert AED → display currency.
Forecast (Tab 5)
Monthly growth rates. Leave Base on Auto to use the trailing-6-month compound growth of actual MRR.
Churn-risk watchlist (Tab 6)
Controls when a client is flagged as at-risk.
Cohort & LTV (Tab 4)
How far the retention triangle and lifetime estimate look.
How precedence works
1. A value you set on this tab always wins.  2. If you leave a field on its default and a matching row exists in the Google Sheet's Global Assumptions tab (e.g. "AED to USD rate", "Base monthly growth %"), that sheet value is used.  3. Otherwise the built-in default applies. The source shown next to each field tells you which one is active. Values you set here are saved in this browser only — set them in the Google Sheet if you want them shared with everyone who opens the dashboard.
